name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: A housing initiative providing affordable housing to the urban and rural poor.
eligibility_criteria: Family income must be below Rs. 18 Lakhs per year
Must not own a pucca house in their name anywhere in India
Must be a citizen of India
benefits: Direct financial assistance for house construction
application_process: Apply online through the PMAY portal or visit the local Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and income proof.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
description: National public health insurance fund aiming to provide free access to health insurance coverage for low income earners.
eligibility_criteria: Must belong to SECC 2011 database deprived categories
Rural: households with no adult male earner
Urban: informal sector workers like ragpickers, domestic workers
No age limit
benefits: Health coverage up to Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization
application_process: Check eligibility online at pmjay.gov.in. If eligible, visit an empaneled hospital with Aadhaar or Ration Card to generate an Ayushman Card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: A central sector scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a landholding farmer family
Cultivable land ownership in the farmer's name
Institutional land holders and taxpayers are excluded
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs. 6,000 per year
Payable in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every 4 months directly to bank accounts
application_process: Apply online via PM-KISAN portal or contact local patwari/revenue officer or CSCs. Requires Aadhaar and Bank Account details.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: An Indian labour law and social security measure that aims to guarantee the 'right to work' by providing 100 days of wage employment in a financial year.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a citizen of India
Must reside in a rural area
Must be 18 years of age or older
Willing to do unskilled manual work
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per household per year
Unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days
application_process: Register at the local Gram Panchayat to obtain a Job Card. Request work application in writing.

name: Stand Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
eligibility_criteria: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur
Above 18 years of age
Enterprise must be a greenfield project in manufacturing, services, or trading sector
Not in default to any bank
benefits: Composite loan of 75% of the project cost
application_process: Apply directly at the bank branch, through the Stand-Up India portal, or via the Lead District Manager (LDM).

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: A government-backed savings scheme targeted at the parents of girl children, encouraging them to build a fund for future education and marriage expenses.
eligibility_criteria: Account can be opened by the parent or legal guardian of a girl child
The girl child must be below 10 years of age
Only one account per girl child, max two per family
benefits: High interest rate (subject to quarterly revision)
Tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act
application_process: Open an account at any post office or authorized commercial bank branch with the child's birth certificate and parent's identity proof.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Scheme aiming to safeguard the health of women and children by providing them with a clean cooking fuel (LPG), so that they don't have to compromise their health in smoky kitchens.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a woman above 18 years of age
Must belong to BPL (Below Poverty Line) family
No other LPG connection in the household
benefits: Financial support of Rs. 1600 for each LPG connection
Free first refill and a hotplate (stove)
application_process: Submit the PMUY application form at the nearest LPG distributor along with KYC documents, Aadhaar, and BPL Ration Card.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
description: A welfare programme comprising of sub-schemes to provide financial assistance to the elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities in the form of social pensions.
eligibility_criteria: Must be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
Old Age Pension: 60 years and above
Widow Pension: 40 years and above
Disability Pension: 18 years and above with severe or multiple disabilities
benefits: Monthly pension ranging from Rs. 200 to Rs. 500 depending on the sub-scheme and age
application_process: Apply at the Gram Panchayat, Municipality, or Block/District social welfare office with BPL proof and relevant certificates.
